g.title: one
g.text: one per gene: first by transcripts.sort
then longest CDS, else longest span

g.title: zoom
g.text: by zoom: all up to 100 bp/px,

g.title: plain
g.text: fixed: full then isoforms, then scroll.
grow: full, and never a trim

g.title: ladder
g.text: each rung is laid out lazily

g.title: ship
g.text: each primitive stamped with the gene
child it belongs to, plus a per-gene

g.title: scale
g.text: one uniform scale over the kept rung:
shortest drawn box hits its floor

g.title: isoforms
g.text: isoforms: each gene trimmed to the largest
fits, found by bisection — names before

g.title: thinned
g.text: thinned: every name kept, bodies shortened
to the largest scale that fits, down to
0.4x the label font — names before height

g.title: decimated
g.text: decimated: a name only where it is
isolated, the factor solved with bodies at
that floor, or at the squeeze floor where
no name survives it; then bodies grow back

g.title: bare
g.text: bare: subfeature labels dropped too; a
rung only where below label rows are
